import sys,time,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import networkx as nx
random.seed(42)
R=4096; O=8192; E=262144
# request quota tree: say 512 nodes, path depth <=32, random forest roots
rqN=512
G=nx.DiGraph()
S='S';T='T';BIG=10**15
G.add_node(S,demand=-R);G.add_node(T,demand=R)
# request quota nodes: numbered R0..; parent random earlier tree
rq=[f'R{i}' for i in range(rqN)]
parents={}
roots=[]
for i in range(rqN):
    if i<20 or random.random()<0.05:
        parents[i]=None;roots.append(i)
    else:
        # choose ancestor depth <31
        p=random.randrange(i)
        # compute depth
        d=0;x=p
        while parents.get(x) is not None:
            d+=1;x=parents[x]
        if d>=31:
            parents[i]=None;roots.append(i)
        else: parents[i]=p
for i in range(rqN):
    cap=random.randrange(0,4097)
    if parents[i] is None:
        G.add_edge(S,rq[i],capacity=cap,weight=0)
    else:
        G.add_edge(rq[parents[i]],rq[i],capacity=cap,weight=0)
for r in range(R):
    rn=f'r{r}'
    g=random.randrange(rqN)
    G.add_edge(rq[g],rn,capacity=1,weight=0)
# offer quota tree
oqN=512
oq=[f'OQ{i}' for i in range(oqN)]
opars={};oroots=[]
for i in range(oqN):
    if i<20 or random.random()<0.05:
        opars[i]=None;oroots.append(i)
    else:
        p=random.randrange(i);d=0;x=p
        while opars.get(x) is not None:
            d+=1;x=opars[x]
        if d>=31:opars[i]=None;oroots.append(i)
        else:opars[i]=p
for i in range(oqN):
    cap=random.randrange(0,4097)
    if opars[i] is None:
        G.add_edge(oq[i],T,capacity=cap,weight=0)
    else:
        G.add_edge(oq[i],oq[opars[i]],capacity=cap,weight=0)
for j in range(O):
    on=f'o{j}';g=random.randrange(oqN)
    G.add_edge(on,oq[g],capacity=random.randrange(0,20),weight=0)
# cross edges random
import itertools
pairs=set()
while len(pairs)<E:
    pairs.add((random.randrange(R),random.randrange(O)))
for r,j in pairs:
    G.add_edge(f'r{r}',f'o{j}',capacity=1,weight=random.randrange(0,10**9))
# dummy
G.add_edge(S,T,capacity=R,weight=BIG)
print('built',G.number_of_nodes(),G.number_of_edges())
t=time.time();cost,flow=nx.network_simplex(G);print('done',time.time()-t,'cost',cost)
